description: One entry of a Menu: an action (with onSelect), a MenuItem.radio option, a MenuItem.label over a few items, or MenuItem.separator between groups.

constructors.description: An action labelled label; onSelect runs after the menu has closed and focus has returned to its opener.

params.name: label
params.description: The item's label; read by a screen reader, matched by type-ahead.

params.name: onSelect
params.description: Called after the menu has closed; null for a separator.

params.name: shortcut
params.description: Shown at the end in TsuyaType.mono; seen, not read.

params.name: checked
params.description: Ticked at the end when true, and announced as a checkbox item (a radio item for MenuItem.radio) when not null.

params.name: destructive
params.description: In TsuyaColors.danger; put it last, after a MenuItem.separator.

params.name: disabled
params.description: Takes focus but cannot be chosen.

constructors.name: radio
constructors.description: An option of which one in a run of radio items is checked, announced as a radio menu item and ticked at the end when it is. Choosing it runs onSelect (the caller moves the check), after the menu has closed.

params.name: label
params.description: The item's label; read by a screen reader, matched by type-ahead.

params.name: onSelect
params.description: Called after the menu has closed; null for a separator.

params.name: checked
params.description: Ticked at the end when true, and announced as a checkbox item (a radio item for MenuItem.radio) when not null.

params.name: shortcut
params.description: Shown at the end in TsuyaType.mono; seen, not read.

params.name: disabled
params.description: Takes focus but cannot be chosen.

constructors.name: label
constructors.description: A heading over a few items, in TsuyaType.caption and TsuyaColors.textMuted. It is not an item: focus, arrows and type-ahead pass it, and it cannot be chosen.

params.name: label
params.description: The item's label; read by a screen reader, matched by type-ahead.

constructors.name: separator
constructors.description: A hairline between groups of items, as before a destructive one.
